correctness.rationale: For ordinary first-order quantifier rank <=2 over undirected adjacency and TWO NAMED unary colours, a pointed rank-one type is determined exactly by its vertex colour, set of neighbour colours and set of distinct non-neighbour colours. Consequently a structure’s rank-two theory is exactly its set of pointed types. In word notation each local type is recoverable from 3-symbol windows and total count of each colour capped at FOUR, as local window uses at most three positions. Deterministic append transitions are closed under both colours; independent BFS reconstructs exactly 760 reachable finite states, 70 distinct theory signatures, 62 mixed-colour signatures, shortest lengths distribution (2,3,6,10,14,18,10,5,0,2), and precisely two length-10 witness words 0011001100 and 1100110011. Direct word enumeration independently corroborates signatures for all binary words through n=11; all-n result follows only from complete 760-state transition closure. Structural run proof forces at least two 1-runs and three 0-runs of size >=2 for the first 10-word signature.

value.rationale: The classification gives a complete small-model theorem for a canonical graph class with named unary colours and ordinary bounded quantifier depth, plus a concrete sharp expression/model-size boundary ten. It distinguishes undirected adjacency reducts from linearly ordered or directed-successor words and gives all 70 attainable logical equivalence classes. This exact natural quotient is independently useful in finite-model theory.

limitations: Nonempty connected undirected paths with exactly two named unary colours; no order/successor or counting quantifiers.
Rank bound fixed at two, no claims about arbitrary tree/graph classes or higher depths.
